Settle, Craven District, North Yorkshire, England

notes: PARENTS LIKELY A FALSE MERGE (research 2026-07-03, open question): the export's parents "Lord Robert Crosby of Holme Hall" and "Lady Constance Brigham" are almost certainly an unrelated, well-documented Yorkshire couple grafted on for prestige. The real Robert Crosby of Holme Hall (Holme-on-Spalding-Moor, East Riding, m. Constance Brigham 1622, d. 1634-1638) had documented children who were DAUGHTERS, emigrating with their widowed mother to Rowley, Massachusetts by 1643 — no record of a son John who stayed in Craven/Settle, Yorkshire (a different part of the county) and fathered this line's Richard Crosby. Treat this generation and above as unsupported legend pending direct Yorkshire parish-register verification. See also notes on I182620315152 and I182620315146.
